WX325MC4P1MDOA(S) — ACB – WiNmaster 3
Breaking capacity class MC (800 V AC selection)
**MC** is the 800 V AC breaking-capacity selection on FRAME-1. It is not listed in the brochure ordering-code key; it appears as a pricelist table column headed **"MC (42kA @ 800V AC)"**.

| Rating | Value |
|---|---|
| Rated ultimate breaking capacity Icu @ 800V ac | 42 kA |
| Frame | FRAME-1 (I Frame) |

This matches the brochure's FRAME-1 figures at 800 V ac, where Icu = 42 kA and Icw (1s) = 42 kA, with Ics = 100% of Icu.
headings: Breaking capacity class MC (800 V AC selection)
